verdict.rationale: Alloy is an API-first identity and fraud platform, so a versioning and deprecation-policy story is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions API versions, version pinning, changelogs, or a deprecation policy. The cited docs cover events, webhooks, health signals and workflows, none of which concern versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
